lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Base plate to front side flange, about 90 deg. In full-res perpendicular sections at 3/25/50/75/97% the label sits on the outer arc apex: label-to-apex 0.04-0.20 mm, nearest surface 0.03-0.08 mm. The flange face (plate b) spans t -0.5..268.5 and the line covers 0..267.9. Sections at 0% and 100% show the flange end faces, so the extent is right.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Base plate to back-left tab 5/6, about 89.5 deg. Label-to-outer-apex is 0.07-0.21 mm at all stations. The tab face spans t -1.5..106.5 and the line covers 0..106.7, so the 117 mm override extent matches the tab. The tab is a separate plate from B3: a roughly 90 mm full-height gap with no flange at all, seen in the front and back views. That makes it two distinct folds, not a window-interrupted single fold.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Base plate to back-right tab 8/9, about 89.4 deg. Label-to-apex is 0.01-0.10 mm. The tab face spans t -0.5..70.5 and the line covers 0..70.2.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: Base plate to the upper leg of the joggled side flange, about 88.5 deg. Label-to-apex is 0.06-0.14 mm. The upper-leg face spans t -0.5..202.5 and the line covers 0..201.4, about 1 mm short at one end, which is negligible. The window in the upper leg at mid-length does not interrupt the fold line, and the outer arc is present at 50%.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: Joggle bend 1, about 90 deg: upper leg to the roughly 10 mm inward step. Wide sections perpendicular to the flange show the Z-profile clearly: an about 19 mm leg, then the step, then a 13 mm lower leg. The label is on the outer (outside-bottom) arc apex at every station, label-to-apex 0.04-0.14 mm. The upper leg and step both span t -0.5..203.5, which matches the line (0..203).

lines.label: B6
lines.reason: Joggle bend 2, about 88.7 deg: step to the lower leg. The outer arc is scanned only on the lower-leg side up to near the apex, and the step's top face is mostly unscanned. Even so, the label lies on the outer arc: 0.02/0.29/0.11 mm at 50/25/75%, and 0.51-0.66 mm at the 3%/97% ends, where it is extrapolated just past the scanned arc end. That is still under 1 mm. The lower leg exists only over t -1.5..189.5, and near both ends the step continues without a lower leg. So the line extent of 0..188.5 matches the real fold.
